apps.localizedDescription: PvZ2: AltVerZ, the Plants vs. Zombies 2 mod, on iPhone and iPad. No jailbreak and no emulator: the game's Android code is converted ahead of time into ordinary, signed Apple code, so it runs full screen at your display's refresh rate, with sound, saves and the mod's own content built in. This is an early build, so expect bugs. The app downloads the game's data (about 1.1 GB) on its first launch, so keep it open on Wi-Fi until the game starts.

versions.localizedDescription:
The first AltVerZ build, and an early one: expect bugs. PvZ2 AltVerZ 1.8.3f runs natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with no jailbreak, no JIT and no emulator.

• The Mac build is the tested one: the title screen, the world map, the Store, the Almanac and levels work, including with a save moved over from Android.
• iPhone and iPad builds have had only light testing. Treat them as a preview.
• The game's own content, AltVerZ's War world and its levels are there.

Known gaps

• AltVerZ has no Import/Export screen, so moving a save over is a file copy. The README has the folders.
• The Mac app is not notarized: the first time, macOS refuses to open it until you allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
• The Mac app checks this repository's update feed. Later builds will show up there; this one is the first.
• This is a prerelease. It is marked as such on GitHub and is not a stable build.

entitlements.name: get-task-allow
entitlements.description: A development-signing flag that lets a debugger attach. The game does not need it to run.

entitlements.name: dynamic-codesigning
entitlements.description: Not used: the game runs without generating code at run time. It is ignored on a stock device.

entitlements.name: com.apple.developer.kernel.increased-memory-limit
entitlements.description: The game and its 1.1 GB of data like more memory than the default allowance. It works without it.

entitlements.name: com.apple.developer.kernel.extended-virtual-addressing
entitlements.description: More address space for the game's large data. It works without it.
